To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the value of servitization is determined by the customer's perception of the value of the service and the value of the product.
the value of a complex deployed responsive service is determined by the service provider’s ability to deliver the service in a manner that meets the customer’s needs.

the key drivers of servitization are the ability of a firm to: (1) identify and understand the needs of the customer; (2) provide the customer with the right service at the right time; (3) provide the customer a solution to the problem; and (4) provide the customer an opportunity to grow.
In summary, our research is concerned with
understanding how manufacturing firms are transforming from a product orientation to a service orientation, and the value they are creating for their customer.

the value of servitization in the engineering context, where servitization is defined as a shift in focus from product sales towards the sale of complex service provision where value is determined by the customer’s perception of success.
the transformation of manufacturing engineering firms from a focus on the production of products to a focus on the delivery of services within the customer’s environment.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the value of a service is the value of its benefits minus the value of its costs.
the value is in the service, and the service is in the value.
the service is delivered in a dynamic environment and its value is determined by how well it meets the customer’s needs.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the value framework captures the transformation of the firm from product to a service firm and how the service is delivered.
the value framework captures how firms are transforming from a product orientation to a complex deployed responsive service orientation and the value that is created in the process of transformation.
the paper presents a framework for value creation in the context of complex deployed service, and that this framework can be used to guide the design of complex deployed services.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the customer’s environment is a key determinant in value creation and the ability to capture value is determined by the ability to deliver services that are responsive to the dynamic customer’s environment.
value is created when a customer’s problem is solved.
the value of a service offering is a function of the value of the service, the cost of providing the service, and the value of the customer's experience with the service provider.
